purpose: Create a compact, complete-chart candidate family for a one-session common industry demand/supply shock. Every Friday contributes one strongest-industry continuation candidate and one weakest-industry repair candidate when coverage is valid.
novelty: This is not the tested 20-session industry momentum/rotation, minute leader-follower propagation, stock short reversal, or a dispersion-threshold rescue. The score is the PIT-industry median one-session stock return and the selected stock is the industry medoid, so the event represents common industry demand rather than an extreme individual mover.

mother_definition.clock: Friday completed daily close; no signal in holiday weeks without a Friday bar
mother_definition.eligible_security: exact valid prior-60 history; hard/current/tradable/market-rule/corporate-action/historical-identity/PIT-industry valid; non-ST; available_at <= decision_at; positive coordinate prices and amount
mother_definition.industry_score: median signal-session step_return among eligible current PIT-industry members
mother_definition.representative_stock: eligible member minimizing absolute step_return minus industry_score; tie break by larger amount then lexical symbol
mother_definition.deduplication: exactly one representative event per direction lane per Friday

event_lifecycle.entry: first legal non-limit-up open during signal+1 through signal+3
event_lifecycle.exit: target when first legally sellable after T+1; otherwise first legal sellable open at/after horizon
event_lifecycle.lineage: unchanged invalid_step_cum from signal; fail closed on coordinate break

chart_contract.window: 126 completed sessions before through 126 after signal
chart_contract.required_review: view every chronological sheet before chart-rule freeze
chart_contract.market_context: join the already accepted signal-date causal BULL/BEAR/TRANSITION state for annotation only; no future-state classification

later_gate.after_chart_compression: every year 2014-2020 must have >50 completed events and mean net event return >4.0%
later_gate.validation: only then open 2022-2024 once under frozen rules
